title: Preserve short Antigravity assistant
result: Decode the existing Antigravity text field paths directly, preserving short, multilingual, multiline and repeated visible replies while excluding reasoning and tool siblings. Keep the generic protobuf walker and its established behavior unchanged.
evidence: The old converter fails eight of nine new end-to-end cases; the corrected focused suite passes all 36 cases. Both uv lock --check commands pass in an isolated pair at the exact .brain-engine-ref. codeality-py gate --json passes all seven required stages with coverage threshold 65 unchanged. pnpm run check:ci --maxWorkers=1 passes 1344 tests across 304 files, retaining one baseline skipped file and one todo. All actual source and installed dependency trees remain exact. An independent read-only supplementary proof qualifies the exact 1185 native Vitest compiler-cache additions after the initial wrapper classification rejected them; the original failed wrapper result is retained and tests were not rerun. Two complete synthetic rendering comparisons are deterministic. No real session conversion, schedule or resident runtime was changed.
